d: The Supreme Court has set aside the Allahabad High Court orders directing the CBI and ED to examine allegations of disproportionate assets against Congress leader Rahul Gandhi. The case has been sent back to the Allahabad High Court for a fresh hearing before a new bench. The Supreme Court said Rahul Gandhi must be made a party to the case and given an opportunity to present his side before any decision is taken. The petition was filed by BJP worker S. Vignesh Shishir, who alleged that Rahul Gandhi had assets disproportionate to his known sources of income. The Supreme Court has not ruled…
